definitions.current: Existing whole-component brightness cuts disable at interior median; edges independent.
definitions.capped: Prototype: effective brightness cutoff min(requested, interior median - 1), including Auto. Other rules unchanged.
definitions.unguarded: Prototype: remove median guard. Other rules unchanged.
definitions.reversal: Previously cut source pixel returns to second-color ink when Cuts increases by one.
definitions.limitations: Geometry and deterministic sweeps; not a recognition study. Median cap preserves less-than-half four-neighbor interior brightness cuts, not topology or total cuts including Edges/Trim.
